reason: A CSS-only DSH Web plugin for customizing the visual appearance of the running thinking-status indicator with configurable text, animations, images, colors, direction, and size.

summaries.zh: 通过配置文本、动画图片、颜色、方向和尺寸，自定义 DSH Web 运行中状态指示器的视觉呈现。
summaries.en: Customize the DSH Web running-status indicator with configurable text, animated images, colors, movement direction, and size.

capabilities: customizes the visual presentation of an existing web status element
provides a settings panel for text, animation, colors, direction, and size
stores settings and some Data URL images in browser localStorage
loads configured HTTPS images directly in the browser
accepts selected local GIF, APNG, and WebP files
